title: AI Systems Engineering 技术雷达（高信号版）

signals.title: Agent skills are becoming versioned, evaluated, optimizable artifacts
signals.summary: Microsoft Research SkillOpt treats skill files as trainable parameters and uses bounded edits, validation gates, edit budgets, and rejected-edit feedback across Codex and Claude Code harnesses.
evidence: Microsoft Research — SkillOpt: Agent skills as trainable parameters

signals.title: Coding agents are acquiring an enterprise control plane
signals.summary: GitHub's session credit limits, session telemetry, GITHUB_TOKEN identity, cost centers, and managed settings show that agent runs need budgets, actor identity, tool traces, cost attribution, and policy distribution.
evidence: GitHub Changelog — Copilot session limits / agent session data / Actions GITHUB_TOKEN / cost centers / managed settings

signals.title: Production agent workflows need a deterministic spine around agentic reasoning
signals.summary: AWS's healthcare claims pipeline uses explicit extraction, validation, transformation, notification, and a deterministic supervisor around an agentic validation node rather than delegating all workflow ordering to the agent.
evidence: AWS Machine Learning Blog — Build an agentic AI healthcare claims pipeline with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and Amazon Bedrock Data Automation

signals.title: Agent workbenches are making provenance and reproducibility first-class
signals.summary: Anthropic Claude Science combines coordinating and specialist agents, reviewer agents, tools, packages, compute boundaries, and auditable artifacts containing the execution chain rather than only a final answer.

signals.title: Long-term memory is shifting from context stuffing to abstraction-guided retrieval
signals.summary: Microsoft Research Memora separates rich memory storage from primary abstractions, cue anchors, and policy-guided retrieval so long-horizon agents inject task-relevant context with lower noise and cost.
evidence: Microsoft Research — Memora: A memory system for long-horizon language agents

ideas.title: Skill Optimization Harness
ideas.summary: Create versioned agent skills, frozen evaluation cases, bounded candidate edits, validation gates, and accepted/rejected JSONL logs; start with 5–10 real coding-agent tasks before automating optimization.
